system.description:
The mage perceives and senses locations at a distance, viewing a remote space as though standing there. By attuning to a known or sympathetically linked place, the caster opens a sensory window to observe events happening elsewhere. Higher successes extend range and clarity of the remote viewing.

Dice Pool: Perception + Awareness (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Correspondence sense effects; mechanics paraphrased.
